nodes.title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx currently renders RoundBadge and Countdown directly inside the scene and silently swallows getCurrentRound failures with .catch(() => setRound(undefined)). HeaderOverlay already exists with loading, error and empty states, but nothing renders it, and GameLayout has no header slot. Desired behavior: GameLayout takes an optional header prop shown as a compact overlay in the game area. App passes HeaderOverlay into it with the round, loading and error state from the existing round fetch. Expected result: the header explains round API failures, and no standalone badge or countdown remains. Why: the redesign requires a compact header overlay with proper loading, empty and error states.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given GameLayout receives a header prop, when it renders, then the header node appears inside the main game area
- Given the round fetch is pending, when App is in the playing view, then the header shows 'Loading round…'
- Given getCurrentRound rejects, when App is in the playing view, then the header shows an alert containing the failure message
- Given the playing view, when App renders, then no standalone RoundBadge or Countdown is rendered outside HeaderOverlay


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout header slot prop
- In scope: App wiring of HeaderOverlay and round loading/error state
- In scope: Removing RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
- In scope: Unit tests with dependencies mocked
- Out of scope: Changing HeaderOverlay internals
- Out of scope: Backend or API changes
- Out of scope: Deleting the RoundBadge or Countdown component files (Countdown is still used by HeaderOverlay)
- Preserve: GameLayout 80/20 grid and mobile drawer behavior
- Preserve: ContributionSheet flow and SceneView/ActionMenu behavior
- Preserve: getCurrentRound API contract


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind classes, Zustand useUiStore
- Use the existing getCurrentRound from src/api/client.ts; no mock data in product code


## Definition of done
- All three requirements implemented and their unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · GameLayout exposes an optional header slot rendered as a compact overlay in the game area
nodes.body:
Context: GameLayout in game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx takes only scene and story. Desired behavior: add an optional header prop rendered inside the relatively-positioned main element so HeaderOverlay (absolute, top) overlays the game. Expected result: header content shows in the game area, and layouts without a header are unchanged. Why: App needs a slot to host the header.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a header prop, when GameLayout renders, then the header node is a descendant of the main element
- Given no header prop, when GameLayout renders, then it renders exactly as before with scene and story
- Given the header slot, when rendered, then the story aside does not contain the header


## Scope
- In scope: header prop on GameLayout
- Out of scope: Header styling changes
- Preserve: Existing grid, drawer toggle and aria-expanded behavior


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind classes only; main already has relative positioning


## Definition of done
- GameLayout renders header slot; layout tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App renders HeaderOverlay through the header slot with round data, loading and error state
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx fetches the round in a useEffect and swallows errors. Desired behavior: keep round, add loading (true until the fetch settles) and error (message string from the rejection, e.g. Error.message) state, remove the silent catch, and render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle round loading error /> as the GameLayout header prop. Expected result: the header shows loading, round info, or an explained failure. Why: users must understand when the round API fails.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given getCurrentRound is pending, when the playing view renders, then 'Loading round…' is shown
- Given getCurrentRound resolves a round, when the playing view renders, then the round id and status are shown in the header
- Given getCurrentRound rejects with Error('boom'), when the playing view renders, then an alert contains 'boom'
- Given the header, then it is rendered inside the layout main area


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx state and header wiring
- Out of scope: HeaderOverlay changes
- Out of scope: Retry logic
- Preserve: Intro gate
- Preserve: roundId passed to ContributionSheet


## Technical constraints
- Use existing getCurrentRound and HeaderOverlay props (worldTitle, round, loading, error)


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- App passes round, loading and error to HeaderOverlay; no silent catch remains


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Old RoundBadge and Countdown usage is removed from App
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx renders RoundBadge and Countdown directly at the top of the scene. Desired behavior: delete those imports and JSX, since HeaderOverlay shows status and countdown. Expected result: only one countdown (inside the header) exists. Why: avoid duplicated round UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a resolved round, when the playing view renders, then exactly one timer element exists (inside the header)
- Given the playing view, then no element from RoundBadge renders outside the header
- Given App.tsx source, then it does not import RoundBadge or Countdown


## Scope
- In scope: Removing imports and JSX from App.tsx
- Out of scope: Deleting component files
- Preserve: HeaderOverlay's own Countdown usage


## Dependencies
- REQ2


## Definition of done

- None
